pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly polygonal dark regions with rounded vertices and soft pixel gradients at the boundaries. Larger spatial area is observed on the central flank, transitioning to smaller, fragmented shapes on the neck and lower visible limbs.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected lattice of cream-toned negative space. Junction nodes exhibit primarily tri-directional intersections. Path continuity is high with relatively uniform pixel width between patches across the mid-section.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the upper neck and dorsal ridge, indicating a short, erect mane against the background.
